scope: PET main menu labels; the katakana are pixels in raw BG tiles, so they are redrawn in Hangul and re-tiled in place

font.name: Galmuri9.bdf
font.style: regular weight (user: thin strokes like the EXE3 PET menu), centred vertically in each label box, drop shadow (+1,+1)

evidence: user save PET screen (analysis/runtime/user_save_pet_vram_01/02): BG0 char base 0x06008000, map 0x0600E000 equal to the ROM map; the module copies the tile block to 0x0600D000 (tile 640). Moving the cursor changes only palette 14 colours 8/9: label k draws in colour 8+k and the selected one is set to white, so each label keeps its own colour. The tile block and map have one ROM reference each (the PET module).
